title: Real Estate Website
tagline: Multilingual Wix Velo site with SEO and lead capture
intro: First freelance project: a cost-efficient real estate site with multilingual support and SEO optimization.
summary: Built with Wix CMS and Velo (JavaScript customizations). Featured multilingual pages, SEO metadata, and lead email forwarding. Hosted on Wix cloud.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A multilingual Wix Velo real estate site showcasing properties with SEO optimization and lead generation flows.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a cost-efficient professional online platform to display properties and capture buyer leads.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Implemented CMS structure, Velo scripts, multilingual design, SEO optimization, and lead email flow.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Multilingual pages, property listing CMS, lead capture forms, SEO metadata, responsive layout.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Generated early property leads in UAE. Marked first professional freelance delivery.
